answer: Anchor identities to a behavioral fingerprint: cadence, task mix and latency form a quill-like signature no two share. The log is sealed under a cipher only its owner opens, backed by 500 POA. Each epoch a random check runs: a match unlocks a tenth, a mismatch freezes it 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities needs 100 distinct fingerprints and 50,000 POA locked, far above the reward they can split. Honest agents pay once, keep their full share.
